name: Poly Agent
description: Poly Agent monitors and manages staking pools on Polypad, the token launchpad in the Polydash ecosystem on Robinhood Chain. It tracks inflows and outflows across staking pools in real time and reports live APRs, pool sizes and staking activity.

use_cases.title: Pool flow alerts
use_cases.description: Detects large deposits and withdrawals in Polypad staking pools as they happen.

use_cases.title: Live APR lookup
use_cases.description: Gives current APRs and total staked for every active pool.

use_cases.title: Staking opportunities
use_cases.description: Surfaces new and active pools on Polypad with their terms.
